title: Reflect high-quality data accumulation in platform philosophy
measurement_note: Timing record was created after web-first intake and implementation had started. Early phases are not measured to avoid false precision.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Checked data quality and provenance sources before local edits.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Loaded durable anchors before modifying philosophy and platform identity.

phases.label: Document and deck updates
phases.bottleneck_notes: Updated operating philosophy, platform identity, traceability registry, requirements, specs, source notes, script, deck spec, and HTML.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Playwright reported 26 passed in 6.5s. Other commands passed but the phase wall time was not fully measured.

phases.label: Evaluation and history
phases.bottleneck_notes: Prepared grounding, omission, request trace, work summary, and evaluator input.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The likely bottleneck is keeping cross-workspace philosophy, identity, traceability, requirements, presentation, and history aligned.
improvement_candidates: Add a helper that lists all philosophy-linked files when a new principle is added.
Create a small deck regeneration checklist for presentation-linked philosophy changes.
